answer: A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 174 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. The yarrow graph is validated at intake and the cedar frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and sonnet anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A 69 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
